name: Painting and Decorating
short: A fresh perspective, a careful finish.
intro: Refresh your home or property with considered colour and careful preparation. Enquire about internal and external painting and decorating across Cheshire and surrounding areas.
work: Internal and external painting, subject to the job
Surface preparation and filling
Painting walls and ceilings
Finishing touches for a considered result
benefit: Good decoration begins before the first coat. We focus on preparation, clean workmanship and respect for your property, with the scope and finish agreed as part of your quotation.
note: Tell us which rooms or exterior surfaces need attention, their condition and your preferred timeframe.

name: Gloss Work and Wood Finishing
short: The details that bring a room together.
intro: Give doors, frames and skirting boards a considered finish. Enquire about painting, gloss finishes and varnishing for suitable wooden surfaces.
work: Doors and door frames
Skirting boards and interior woodwork
Painting and gloss finishes
Varnishing suitable wooden surfaces
benefit: Well-finished woodwork helps a space feel complete. Preparation and a suitable finish will be discussed for the surfaces involved. Specialist restoration is not currently advertised.
note: Let us know the type of woodwork, its current finish and the look you would like to achieve.

name: Property Improvements
short: Practical care for the spaces you use.
intro: From filling and painting to general cleaning and garden work, discuss the smaller improvements that can help your property feel cared for.
work: Filling and surface preparation
Painting and finishing
General cleaning
Garden work and minor property improvements
benefit: Bring your list of jobs together in one enquiry. We can discuss what is suitable, agree the scope and provide a free quotation. Electrical, gas, plumbing and other regulated work are not included in this advertised service.
note: A short list of the work and the condition of the property will help us understand your enquiry.

name: Jet Washing and Exterior Cleaning
short: A cleaner welcome to your property.
intro: Enquire about jet washing and cleaning suitable outdoor surfaces. The right approach starts with understanding the surface and its condition.
work: Review of the outdoor surfaces you want cleaned
Jet washing where suitable
General exterior cleaning
An agreed scope based on surface condition
benefit: Exterior cleaning can freshen up outdoor spaces. Suitability is assessed for each enquiry; specialist treatments and surface guarantees are not assumed.
note: Describe the surface, approximate area and any fragile or damaged sections so we can discuss a suitable approach.

name: House MOT and Landlord Maintenance
short: A practical approach to property upkeep.
intro: A practical visual maintenance review for homeowners, landlords and letting agents, with a choice of a one-off visit or agreed ongoing upkeep. The proposed scope below is a draft for review.
work: Visual review of accessible internal and external areas, within an agreed scope
Check for visible wear, decorating needs and minor maintenance jobs
A short written summary of observations and suggested priorities
Separate quotations for agreed repairs, preparation, cleaning or decorating
benefit: Identify visible upkeep needs and plan practical next steps. Findings are observations rather than a specialist diagnosis. Any follow-up work, materials and visits are agreed and quoted separately.
note: Choose a one-off House MOT or ongoing property maintenance. The proposed scope is awaiting final business review.

draftScope.oneOff: One-off House MOT: an agreed visual walk-through of safely accessible areas, covering decorating condition, visible wear to woodwork, general cleaning needs, garden upkeep and suitable exterior cleaning. A short written summary will list observations, suggested priorities and work that may need a specialist. Any maintenance work is quoted separately.
draftScope.ongoing: Ongoing maintenance: scheduled visual reviews and an agreed programme of minor upkeep, such as filling, painting, general cleaning, garden work and suitable exterior cleaning. Visit frequency, access, materials, individual jobs and charges are agreed in writing. Additional or urgent work needs a separate agreement; no emergency response time is promised.
draftScope.exclusions: The House MOT is not a structural survey, safety certification or a guarantee that a property is free of defects. It excludes hidden or inaccessible areas, invasive testing, work at unsafe heights, gas, electrical and plumbing work, and statutory inspections. Suspected specialist issues should be assessed by an appropriately qualified professional.

name: Mould Removal
short: Discuss visible mould and the care your property needs.
intro: Enquire about cleaning visible surface mould on suitable areas of your property across Cheshire and surrounding areas. The extent, surface condition and likely moisture source need to be discussed before work is agreed.
work: Discussion of the affected area and visible surface mould
Surface cleaning where suitable and within an agreed scope
Preparation and redecoration enquiries once the underlying issue has been addressed
Referral for specialist assessment where the extent or cause requires it
benefit: A careful approach starts with understanding the affected area. Surface cleaning does not resolve every cause of damp or condensation, and no permanent removal or health outcome is promised. Extensive, recurring or hidden mould may require a specialist assessment.
note: Tell us where the mould is appearing, the approximate affected area and whether it has returned after previous cleaning. Exact treatment, access and suitability are agreed before a quotation.
